name: moonshine-voice
description: Firefox add-on: local push-to-talk dictation with the Moonshine ASR model

scripts.build: esbuild src/worker.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --outfile=ext/worker.js --alias:@huggingface/transformers=./node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/dist/transformers.web.js --alias:onnxruntime-web/webgpu=./node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort.webgpu.bundle.min.mjs --alias:onnxruntime-web=./node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort.webgpu.bundle.min.mjs && npm run build:tts && npm run copy:wasm
